Subject: Renewal: order form + term updates for Greenbridge Health

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier. Per Greenbridge's FY26 planning, you're looking to renew our subscription and add ~30% more capacity for Q3 (additional dedicated token throughput and a second region). Key asks from my side so we can route to legal:

- 12 month renewal term (start 2026-04-01)
- Increase committed capacity from 4 to 5 dedicated units, with burst pool enabled
- Confirm payment terms: net 45 preferred by finance
- Minor MSA updates: data retention paragraph (30 -> 90 days for logs), and a one-time onboarding credit applied to the first invoice if we extend term to 12 months

I attached a draft order form for your review. If your counsel has redlines, please send them over and I'll loop in Marissa on legal.

Attachments: [attachment: GBH_Renewal_OrderForm_2026_draft.docx (docx, 178 KB)]

Next steps: if we can align on capacity and the one-time credit this week, I'll prepare counters and get legal to deliver a clean DocuSign package.

Best,
Neha Kapoor

Subject: Re: Renewal: order form + term updates for Greenbridge Health

Neha —

Thanks for the draft. Attached is our redline of the order form and the MSA with some comments from legal. High-level summary of our changes and asks:

- Payment: we can move to net 45, but require an invoice submission timeline (invoice due within 30 days of billing period end).
- SLA: request a 10% service credit for any monthly availability below 99.5% (current MSA lists 99.0%).
- Data retention / logs: prefer 180 days for access logs; if not acceptable, we can accept 90 days but must include audit export capability.
- Termination: we are asking for a 90-day termination for convenience (instead of 60) once renewal kicks in.
- Liability cap: small tweak to carve out regulatory fines (we mark this as negotiable).

I've attached a version with tracked changes and inline comments. Please route to your legal and confirm whether Redwood can accept the SLA and termination language; those are critical for our security and procurement teams. Also copied Michael (procurement) for payment terms.

Attachments: [attachment: GBH_Renewal_OrderForm_2026_redlined.docx (docx, 243 KB)], [attachment: Redwood_MSA_v3.1_redline.pdf (pdf, 95 KB)]

Thanks,
Samantha Reed
Head of Digital Ops | Greenbridge Health
samantha.reed@greenbridgehealth.com | +1 617-555-0899
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: GBH redlines — legal take and proposed counters

Forwarding Greenbridge redlines with notes. Summary of our position after initial review: 

- SLA: we can accept a 99.5% monthly availability target but need to cap credits at 10% for a single month and a 20% aggregate per 12-month period. Suggest adding a service credit matrix rather than open-ended credits.
- Data retention: 90 days is reasonable if we include an audit export capability; 180 days is operationally expensive given cache/KV constraints.
- Termination for convenience: counter to 60 days, not 90. If Greenbridge insists on 90, propose a compromise of 75 days but add a one-time onboarding credit ($15,000) and waive early termination fees for the first renewal year.
- Liability/regulatory carveouts: redline back to standard language; accept limited carveouts for regulatory fines but require proof of assessment by their counsel.

Ask for Neha/Jonas: confirm whether the customer approved the increased committed units (4->5) and whether sales ops can accept net 45 vs net 30 for invoicing (finance may need net 30 for payment timing). I'm attaching our internal legal comment file.

Attachments: [attachment: MSA_redline_comments_legal.docx (docx, 62 KB)]

Samantha —

Appreciate the clear redlines and context. We reviewed with legal and sales ops and can propose the following counter-proposals that should address your procurement/security priorities while keeping operational predictability: 

1) SLA: Accept 99.5% monthly availability. Service credit matrix attached; cap credits at 10% for a single month and 20% aggregate over 12 months.
2) Data retention: We can accept 90 days for access logs and will include an audit export tool for compliance exports (we will document process in the appendix).
3) Termination: We cannot move to 90 days unconditional. Counter: 75 days for termination for convenience during the renewal term. As a concession, we will apply a one-time onboarding credit of $15,000 on the first invoice if Greenbridge executes the 12-month renewal and committed capacity increase.
4) Payment terms: We can accept net 45, with the invoice submission timeline you requested (invoice due within 30 days of billing period end). Finance will need an ACH remittance notice with the invoice.
5) Liability carveouts: We will keep our standard cap with a limited carveout for regulatory fines; legal to coordinate proof-of-assessment language offline.

If those points sound acceptable, we will prepare a clean order form and updated MSA and send via DocuSign today. Per your ask, Jonas will confirm committed units separately — Jonas: please confirm the 5-unit commit (and region add) so I can finalize pricing.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/embedded/signing/xyz-GBH-2026
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/GBH-7890

Thanks,
